summary: Reviewed all four test files against their respective source classes. Test assertions are logically correct: BOM stripping path in TextConverter is exercised when source==target==UTF-8 (conversion skipped but BOM strip block still runs); SelectorParser::match parameter ordering (exp, pattern, value) matches test call signatures; readonly enforcement tests correctly expect \\Error from PHP for private property write attempts; Settings::get() fallback to MAX_FILE_SIZE at runtime is correctly tested by clearing 'max-filesize' key first. No bugs or gaps detected."

summary: Code review of WP-004 unit tests. All files follow project conventions: strict_types=1, PSR-4 namespace Tests\\Unit, extend PHPUnit\\Framework\\TestCase, use void return types on all test methods. Tests are well-scoped (one concern per test), tearDown correctly resets static Settings state to prevent cross-test contamination. SelectorParser tests correctly instantiate from a real DOM context. ErrorTest uses @phpstan-ignore-next-line to suppress static analysis on intentionally invalid property writes. No code smells or structural issues found."
